title: Treatise on Armor Seams and the Narrow Point
summary: Teaches the thrusts that find the seams of mail and plate and how to ready qi in the point.

title: The Qi-Fed Dagger Canon
summary: Sets out how a Xiantian-field cultivator feeds qi through the dagger for sustained cuts and chains.

title: Advanced Counter-Thrust Studies
summary: Drills the reflecting counters that return an opponent's thrust along the same line.

title: Book of Hidden Carry and Sudden Draw
summary: Teaches concealed carry and the sudden draw strokes from sleeve, cloak and boot at full qi power.

title: Rules of the Throwing Blade at Distance
summary: Sets out the qi-driven throw of the dagger and the guards that protect a thrower.

title: The Twin-Track Dagger Reading
summary: Teaches the dagger as the second track of a paired fighter, working beside the main weapon.

title: Hawk Stoop and Blade Return
summary: Drills the plunging stoop-thrust of the hawk style and the return to guard that follows it.

title: Basin Court Short Blade Studies
summary: Sets out the close-court dagger work of the basin schools, built on paired steps and counters.

title: Paired Edges of the Azure River
summary: Teaches the paired-edge cuts of the river style, where two blades or two tracks move as one.

title: Wind-Sworn Lessons for the Short Dagger
summary: Teaches the wind-sworn dagger forms that favor lightness, sudden angle and a return to open ground.

title: The Bearing of the Plateau Dagger
summary: Sets out how the plateau schools hold a bearing with the dagger and cut along a fixed line.

title: Oath and Edge on the Open Rim
summary: Teaches the oath-held dagger work of the open rim, where a sworn duty sets the line of every cut.

title: Crosswind Studies for the Narrow Steel
summary: Drills crosswind cuts and slips that move the dagger fighter off the line of a heavier blow.
